title: Layout standard: reserved zones, zone map, insets, scale, floors, HUD zones, UI budgets
description: Derived from the zones data by scripts/export_design_pack.py --write-schemas: every key present today is required and typed. Unknown keys are allowed everywhere (minor versions add keys); readers ignore them.

provenance.description: documented: Roblox docs, staff posts or filings; field: observed while shipping a game (dated when known); measured: we measured it: engine source, pixels on reference frames, store API reads, tested in Studio; opinion: judgment, house style, owner rule or a community starting value

v.description: the value; units are in the key name (_px, _s, _share, _scale, _rgb, _studs, _deg); [a, b] under a unit key is a range or a width-height size
